features.feature: Privacy-preserving usage-evidence envelope type (PrivacyPreservingUsageEvidenceEnvelope) and builder function (buildUsageEvidenceEnvelope) encoding a ledger record as digests + non-secret fields (model, provider name, usage counts, source, correlation ids, decision)
Privacy denylist enforcement: envelope must contain NO raw prompt/transcript/secret/key/auth-header material
Envelope contains a recordDigest (e.g. sha256 of the canonical record) field
Receipt-reference fields on the authority block: nullable receiptId, receiptSubjectKind, receiptSubjectId
Local records keep authority.receiptVerified=false and receiptId=null by default (local Non-authority boundary rule)
Validator enforces: receiptId/receiptSubjectKind/receiptSubjectId may be non-null only together, but that alone does NOT set receiptVerified=true
Pluggable verification gate: verifyUsageReceipt(envelope, signedReceipt, verifyFn) that sets receiptVerified=true ONLY when injected verifyFn confirms verified=true AND subject binding matches
Zero cross-module imports: usage-ledger module must NOT import authority-signing module (verifier injected)
Gate returns receiptVerified=false when injected verifier returns verified=true but subject binding mismatches
Gate returns receiptVerified=false when injected verifier returns verified=false
Negative control: transport accepted=true is NOT verification (receiptVerified stays false)
Negative control: provider response with real token counts is NOT verification (receiptVerified stays false)
Negative control: local JSONL hash chain is NOT verification (receiptVerified stays false)
Negative control: copied receiptId without injected verifier confirming signature+subject is NOT verification (receiptVerified stays false)
Smoke suite wired as npm test:usage-ledger-authority covering envelope, nullable receipt-ref fields, verification gate (verified only via injected verifier + subject match), and all negative controls
Smoke asserts usage-ledger imports ZERO other modules (no authority-signing import)
No regression on full ledger suite (usage-ledger/-adapter/-estimate/-diagnostics/-dispatch/-budget) + lattice validate
Authority Server itself (live server, network submission of evidence envelopes, real Ed25519 crypto verification, promoting local records to receipt-backed authority by default)
features.excluded_by: Out of scope per description: the Authority Server itself, network submission, real signature crypto (verifier is injected/pluggable), promoting any local record to receipt-backed authority by default
